story: Duryodhana, eldest of the hundred Kaurava brothers, grew up jealous of his Pandava cousins. He tried to poison Bhima and burn the Pandavas alive in a house of lac, took their kingdom in a rigged dice game, and refused to give back even five villages, which started the war.
belief: He is the chief villain of the Mahabharata, but he is also remembered for his loyalty to Karna and his refusal to surrender. He is worshipped at the Poruvazhy Peruviruthy Malanada temple in Kerala.
turns: He ordered Draupadi's humiliation in the court. He refused every peace offer, including Krishna's, saying he would not give up even as much land as the point of a needle.
facts: He is also called Suyodhana, 'good fighter'.
Before the war he chose Krishna's army over Krishna himself.
He was killed by Bhima's blow to his thigh.
